observations: Multiple stacks of used car tires in an outdoor setting.
Tires are covered in dirt and mud, indicating heavy use.
Tread depth is visibly worn on the outer edges of the tires.
Tires are stacked in piles, suggesting a bulk or wholesale inventory.
A watermark 'IKWE ANTHONY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across all photos.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Tread depth may be insufficient for legal use on public roads.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tread depth gauge (e.g., 2mm or 4mm) on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: as having very low tread depth

risks.risk: Tires may be past their expiration date (DOT code).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the DOT code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: Tires may be damaged internally (blown out or cracked).
risks.proof: A video showing a professional internal inspection or a photo of the tire's inner surface.

risks.risk: The actual size and model (e.g., 205/55R16) are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sidewall showing the size and brand.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the sidewall showing the brand, size, and DOT code.
Photo of the tread depth gauge.
Photo of the inner surface of the tires to check for cracks or damage.
Video of a professional inspection of the tires.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
